company_description: First Quantum Minerals Ltd. is a global mining company focused on copper, with secondary production of nickel, gold, silver, and molybdenum. It develops and operates complex mines through in-house technical and operational expertise.

kpis.name: Copper Production
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of copper produced in thousands of metric tons.

kpis.name: Nickel Production
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of nickel produced in thousands of metric tons.

kpis.name: Cobre Panamá Project
kpis.description: Cobre Panamá, 91% owned, is becoming a production pillar with 396,000 tons of copper in 2025, reinforcing First Quantum's position as a major producer.

risks.title: Foreign exchange exposure and currency risk
risks.summary: A significant portion of revenue is exposed to fluctuations in foreign currencies (EUR, USD, JPY, CNY). A sharp movement in the dollar or major trading currencies can mechanically impact consolidated margins.
risks.score_rationale: Standard FX risk for multinationals. Position Item 1A top 10 typical. Standard language on translation and transaction. Stable trend. Moderate FX weighting for exporters.

risks.title: Macroeconomic environment and global recession risk
risks.summary: A sustained slowdown in global growth, geopolitical tensions, or a sharp rise in interest rates may affect demand, margins, and the valuation of underlying assets.
risks.score_rationale: Standard macro risk. Position Item 1A generally present. Standard language on cycle sensitivity. Stable trend but post-2022 magnitude. Moderate macro weighting.

risks.title: Sector competition and market share pressure
risks.summary: Intensifying competition in the sector may exert sustained pressure on volumes, selling prices, and operating margins. A significant loss of market share would have a material impact on the financial trajectory.
risks.score_rationale: Cross-cutting competition risk. Standard Item 1A positioning. Usual language on competitive intensification. Stable trend. Moderate competition weighting.

risks.title: Sensitivity to profit warnings and guidance revisions
risks.summary: First Quantum Minerals Ltd. remains exposed to the risk of downward revisions to its quarterly or annual guidance in case of material deviation between operational performance and market expectations. No formal profit warning has been identified over the past twelve months.
risks.score_rationale: Continuously monitored profit warning risk. No formal profit warning communication in the last 12 months. Item 1A position non-specific (cross-cutting risk). Stable trend. Moderate profit warning weighting.
